# alkira_multi_cloud_gateway (Data Source)

Retrieve an existing Multi-Cloud Gateway by its exact name. The lookup searches all pages and fails with the match count if zero or multiple gateways have that name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The exact name of the gateway.

### Read-Only

- `billing_account_number` (String) The Lumen billing account number (BAN) this gateway bills to.
- `external` (Boolean) True if the gateway was created in Lumen Connect rather than from Alkira.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `native_id` (String) Native gateway ID assigned by Lumen.
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the gateway.
- `tier` (String) The gateway bandwidth tier reported by the API.
